# DoseShift: Pill Reminder App

DoseShift is a free Android pill reminder app for one interval-based medication plan. It calculates the next reminder from the time a user marks the current dose as taken.

## Product facts

- The core flow is: mark “Taken now” -> the next reminder shifts by the configured interval.
- The user chooses the medication name, first planned time, interval, and maximum daily doses from their prescription. DoseShift does not provide medical advice.
- The current MVP supports one active medication plan, local Android notifications, a local history, pause-until-tomorrow, undo/correction of the most recent dose mark, and Russian/English UI.
- The core function requires no account or cloud sync. Medication-plan and history data remain in local app storage.
- Reminder timing depends on Android permissions, precise-alarm access, volume, and background restrictions.

Do not describe DoseShift as medical advice, a drug-interaction checker, cloud-synced service, multi-medication manager, or a substitute for a clinician.
